title: drawing of a figure in a cap
description: A drawing in magenta line and hatching showing one figure in a flat cap in profile, with typewriter-style English text overlaid at the left and credits at the top right reading “text:sami zibak / drawing: zvonimir”. The overlaid text reads: “MY CLASSMATES, YOUNG MUSLIM AND CHRISTIAN ARAB BOYS WERE ALSO EXPERIENCING THE BUDDING OF THEIR SEXUAL AWAKENING, AND HAVE SINCE BECOME ETCHED IN MY CONSCIOUSNESS AS THE ULTIMATE SEX SYMBOLS, ESPECIALLY AS THEY WERE THE SUBJECTS OF MY VERY FIRST MASTURBATION SESSIONS IN THE SEVENTH GRADE. TO THIS DAY I SEARCH THEIR LIKES ON GAY DATING APPS, DURING MY NOC-TURNAL FORAYS THROUGH THE CRUISING GROUNDS OF SOUTH TEL AVIV, WHERE I HAD THOUGHT IT WOULD BE EASY TO FIND ARAB GUYS TO GET TO HAVE SEX WITH.”
subject_tags: illustration; english text; artwork; portrait

title: drawing of a figure with raised hands

The overlaid text reads: “I WAS A RANDOM SUBURBAN SISSY BOY WHEN QUEERHANA SEDUCED ME AND MADE ME QUEER. IT TOOK A BUNCH OF GENDERFUCKED QUEERS IN GLITTER AND TUTUS TO DO THE WORK THE DEMONSTRATIONS AND BOOKS COULDN’T”.

title: at the mixer with a watching crowd
description: One person with headphones around the neck works a mixer set on a case in low sun while three people crouch and sit watching a few metres away. Bicycles, scooters and pink tape mark the edge of the ground behind, with a bridge at the left.
subject_tags: outdoor; dj; party; crowd; riverbank; daytime

title: canopies and a banner from the bridge
description: Two white canopies stand on the grass beneath a road bridge in low sun, with people lying on mats and others kneeling beside them. A hand-painted Hebrew banner hangs from the bridge parapet above and a large screen stands at the left.
subject_tags: outdoor; bridge; tent; banner; hebrew text; crowd; daytime

title: two canopies on the grass
description: Two white canopies stand side by side on grass beneath a road bridge in low sun, with several people lying on mats and blankets and others kneeling or sitting beside them. Around forty people stand and walk beyond, with strings of small flags in the trees.
subject_tags: outdoor; bridge; tent; crowd; gathering; daytime

title: resting under the canopies
description: Several people lie on mats and blankets beneath two white canopies on grass in low sun while others kneel beside them. Around thirty people stand and walk in the background beneath the bridge, with hanging decorations in the trees.
subject_tags: outdoor; bridge; tent; crowd; gathering; daytime

title: talking across the barrier tape
description: Two people sit talking at the edge of a river in low sun, one in a striped top and the other with a bandana and painted marks on the chest and arm. Red and white barrier tape is strung across the frame in front of them.
subject_tags: outdoor; riverbank; conversation; body paint; daytime

title: standing by the graffitied pier
description: Two people stand close together facing each other in low sun by a river, one with a bandaged upper arm and both in swimwear and wraps. Spray-painted Hebrew on the pier behind reads קוויר חנה 6.2003 (Hebrew: “Queerhana 6.2003”) with an arrow, above a stencilled marking “M520”; a decorated figure and hanging cloths stand at the right.
subject_tags: outdoor; riverbank; graffiti; hebrew text; costume; bridge; daytime

title: seated and standing on the bank
description: Around fifty people sit on the grass and stand in groups beneath a road bridge in low sun, with bags, bottles and blankets on the ground. A loudspeaker and a hand-lettered sign stand at the centre and scooters are parked beyond.
subject_tags: outdoor; crowd; bridge; gathering; loudspeaker; daytime

title: spraying a can over the water
description: One person leans out over the water in low sun holding an aerosol can in one hand and pointing down with the other, wearing a pink scarf and a studded belt. A second person stands at the right at the edge of the frame.
subject_tags: outdoor; riverbank; graffiti; costume; daytime

title: dancing crowd seen from the earth
description: Around a hundred people stand and dance on bare earth beneath a wide road bridge in low sun, with two working at a table of equipment at the centre. Cabling and pink tape run across the ground in the foreground.
subject_tags: outdoor; crowd; party; bridge; dj; daytime

title: table of equipment in the crowd
description: Around a hundred people stand and dance beneath a wide road bridge in low sun, with one working at a table of equipment at the centre and another beside it. One in the crowd wears a long red costume and a peaked cap.
subject_tags: outdoor; crowd; party; bridge; dj; costume; daytime

title: arms raised in the dancing crowd
description: Around a hundred and twenty people stand and dance on bare earth beneath a road bridge in low sun, several with arms raised. Two work at a table of equipment at the centre and cabling runs across the ground.
subject_tags: outdoor; crowd; party; bridge; dj; daytime

title: wide view of the crowd dancing
description: Around a hundred and fifty people stand and dance beneath a wide road bridge in low sun, with loudspeakers on stands at either side. Two work at a table of equipment at the centre and a lamp post rises at the right.
subject_tags: outdoor; crowd; party; bridge; loudspeaker; daytime

title: mannequin legs planted in the earth
description: Mannequin legs and arms stand upright in mounded red earth in the foreground in low sun, with cut branches planted between them and equipment boxes marked “CDJ-100S” stacked at the left. Around eighty people stand and dance beneath the bridge beyond.
subject_tags: outdoor; installation; crowd; party; bridge; english text; daytime

title: police walking through the gathering
description: Around sixty people stand beneath a road bridge in low sun while four uniformed police officers walk through the gathering, one in the foreground crossing the open ground. A table of equipment stands at the centre and cabling runs across the earth.
subject_tags: outdoor; police; crowd; bridge; party; daytime

title: gathering continuing after dark
description: Around fifty people stand and move beneath a road bridge after dark, lit by street lamps and small lights on the ground. A loudspeaker on a stand rises at the centre and equipment is set out on tables at the left.
subject_tags: outdoor; crowd; party; bridge; night; loudspeaker

title: night crowd under the lit bridge
description: Around forty people stand and dance on the ground beneath a road bridge at night, lit by orange street lamps overhead. Flags on the parapet above are lit from below and a loudspeaker stands on a pole at the centre.
subject_tags: outdoor; crowd; party; bridge; night; flag

title: seen through grass at night
description: The gathering continues beneath a road bridge at night, seen low through dry grass and branches in the foreground. Around twenty-five people stand and sit on the ground, lit warmly, with a steel bridge visible at the left.
subject_tags: outdoor; crowd; party; bridge; night; riverbank

title: crowd at night around a lit table
description: Around twenty-five people stand in near-darkness facing a lit table holding equipment, inside a space walled with hanging sheets. A hammock is strung above, and small lamps light the table and the people behind it.
subject_tags: party; dj; crowd; night; loudspeaker; tent

title: applying lipstick at night
description: One person applies lipstick to another's mouth at night in front of a shuttered storefront hung with sheeting, while a third stands beside them holding a camera. Barrier tape strung above reads משטרה – אין מעבר (Hebrew: “police – no entry”).
subject_tags: street; night; costume; makeup; hebrew text; police tape

title: printout of an urban festival email
description: Printout of a Hebrew email headed מניפסטציה (Hebrew: “manifestation”), subject line פסטיבל אורבני (Hebrew: “urban festival”), dated 14 June 2009. It sets out proposals for a festival mapped onto sites of alternative activity in Tel Aviv public space.
subject_tags: hebrew text; ephemera; festival; tel aviv

title: nation monsters screening invitation, print
description: Print-ready poster invitation to a screening of the documentary “Nation Monsters and Superqueers: The Queerhana Collective, Politics and Queer Parties in Israel - Palestine 2001 - 2009”, with a Q&A, at Aquarium am Südblock, Admiralstr. 1-2, Berlin, 28 June 2017.
event: this is a free zone, ngbk berlin, 2017
subject_tags: ephemera; illustration; english text; screening; berlin; logo

title: response to the tel aviv shooting
description: Undated Hebrew opinion piece circulated in the Pink Communities Coalition, written after the 2009 shooting at an LGBTQ youth centre in Tel Aviv and opening בשבת האחרונה הסיוט הפך למציאות (Hebrew: “last Saturday the nightmare became reality”).
subject_tags: hebrew text; ephemera; article; tel aviv

title: straight 100 percent, essay
description: Hebrew essay titled '“משתתפת בצערכם” - סטרייטית 100%' (Hebrew: “‘sharing your grief’ — 100% straight”), recorded in the file's metadata as taken from a Ynet talkback thread, written after the 2009 shooting at an LGBTQ youth centre in Tel Aviv.
subject_tags: hebrew text; ephemera; article; tel aviv

title: playing a keyboard on the floor
description: One person sits on the floor against a plywood wall indoors playing a small electric keyboard resting on a wooden case, with sheet music propped on it. Bright tights and a pale jumper are visible in the low light.
event: allenbeach reclaim the streets action, 15-18 march 2003
subject_tags: indoor; keyboard; music; costume; party

title: carrying an amplifier and cables
description: One person carries a metal-cased amplifier loaded with coiled cables across an indoor space with plywood walls, moving quickly. Another stands at the right and a stack of scaffolding is visible above.
event: allenbeach reclaim the streets action, 15-18 march 2003
subject_tags: indoor; music; party; gathering

title: guitar and gas mask beside the decks
description: One person in a gas mask plays a gold electric guitar against a graffitied wall indoors while two others work at turntables and a mixer at the right. A red printed sign on the wall reads “INFUSE” and tinsel is wound around the equipment.
event: allenbeach reclaim the streets action, 15-18 march 2003
subject_tags: indoor; music; guitar; mask; dj; turntable; graffiti; english text

title: gas mask and gold guitar
description: One person in a gas mask stands holding a gold electric guitar against a wall covered in marker graffiti indoors. Legible writing on the wall includes “Depeche mode 4/9/20…”, “Shoo hAM” and “Goth”.
event: allenbeach reclaim the streets action, 15-18 march 2003
subject_tags: indoor; music; guitar; mask; graffiti; english text; portrait

title: playing guitar next to the turntables
description: One person in a gas mask plays a gold electric guitar in the foreground indoors while two others work at turntables and a mixer along the wall at the right. A red printed sign reading “INFUSE” is taped to the graffitied wall.
event: allenbeach reclaim the streets action, 15-18 march 2003
subject_tags: indoor; music; guitar; mask; dj; turntable; graffiti; english text

title: decorated bicycle at the kerb
description: A red bicycle with a glittered saddle and tinsel wound around the handlebars stands propped against a roadside railing at night. Cars pass in a blur on the road behind.
event: allenbeach reclaim the streets action, 15-18 march 2003
subject_tags: outdoor; bicycle; street; night; decoration

title: applying makeup at night
description: One person applies makeup with a brush to another's face at night in front of hung sheeting, both in costume. A third stands blurred at the left and paper discs hang on strings at the right.
subject_tags: night; makeup; costume; street; gathering; party

title: moving through the crowd at night
description: Four people stand and move close together at night in front of hung sheeting and a shuttered storefront, one blurred in motion across the frame. A printed poster is taped to the wall behind and barrier tape is strung overhead.
subject_tags: night; crowd; party; street; gathering

title: lgtbq coalition logo in black
description: A black-and-white logo showing an open circle with six radiating arms, some ending in arrows and some in crossbars. Lettering below reads קואליציית קהילות להטב״ק (Hebrew: “LGTBQ Communities Coalition”) and, in English, “LGTBQ  Coalition”.
subject_tags: logo; illustration; hebrew text; english text; ephemera

title: two faces at close range
description: A close view of two people standing together outdoors in low sun, one with dark eye makeup and one with pink eye makeup and long strands of small plastic fish worn as jewellery. A road, parked scooters and a bridge are visible behind.
subject_tags: outdoor; makeup; costume; portrait; daytime

title: shadows on the bare earth
description: Long shadows fall across bare red earth in low sun, cast by people standing out of frame. Several pairs of legs and feet in sandals and trainers are visible at the top of the frame.
subject_tags: outdoor; party; crowd; daytime

title: pink communities coalition: statement of intent (2009)
description: Pink Communities Coalition statement of intent, dated 04/08/2009. QueeRhaNA Archives.
subject_tags: hebrew text; ephemera; article; tel aviv
